title: fix(components,plugin-grid,types): chip columns never ellipsize, wide tables show they scroll, Actions only when a row offers one
body:
Fixes #12708
Clause-②: yes

Implemented by session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01SPYcVSSndYVgRePzs2F7sD` on head `a676aad`.

## What the 1024 px readings showed (HotCRM, before this change)

- Knowledge Base, grouped by Category: the Status column is HotCRM's declared `width: 130`. The Published chip (about 70 px) fits and is not ellipsized. It reads "Publish…" because the grouped table (1477 px) scrolls inside a 768 px scroller, and the sticky right-pinned Actions column covers the Status cell at the seam. Nothing showed that the table continues: data-table's existing right-edge shadow (objectui#12463) is skipped for the grouped table, and the grouped scroller drew none.
- Knowledge Base Actions header: every row has a ⋮ menu (Edit, Delete). It stays at opacity 0 until the row is hovered (objectui#12423).
- Approvals Inbox: the table is 1071 px wide in a 718 px box. Requester, Status, Submitted and the inline Approve / Reject column run past the card's edge with no shadow.

## Target 1: chip columns

- `TableColumn` gains one optional member, `chips` (this PR's Clause-② member). A flagged column's minimum width is its widest chip drawn on screen, measured once per data load (a new data prop, page or page size). It rises above a declared width and a user's resize; a wider declared width is kept. Text columns have no floor: they keep their width and truncate first.
- `ObjectGrid` sets the flag at its one column fold for `select`, `status`, `multiselect`, `radio`, `checkboxes` and `tags`, the types `@object-ui/fields` draws as badges.
- data-table measures a chip column even when it has an explicit width, and keeps a cells-only width beside the existing drawn size.

## Target 2: a table wider than its container shows that it scrolls

- Built once, outside `packages/components/src/ui/`, in `custom/use-horizontal-overflow.ts` (the read hook and the class constants) and `custom/horizontal-overflow.tsx` (`HorizontalOverflowBox`). `@object-ui/components` publishes exactly three of these names: `HorizontalOverflowBox`, its props type `HorizontalOverflowBoxProps` and `PINNED_RIGHT_SEAM_SHADOW_CLASSES`. The rest are package-internal.
- While the box can scroll further right it shows a right-edge shadow and sets `data-overflow-right`; the shadow goes away at the right end. The scrollbar shows on hover or focus only. Those utilities carry Tailwind's important modifier, because the console themes every scrollbar with an unlayered rule.
- data-table's own scroll box now decides its shadow with the shared hook. The existing seam overlay and its placement are unchanged.
- The grouped grid's one scroller is now the overflow box. The right-pinned Actions cells draw the shadow on their own left edge, where the content slides under them, so no offset needs measuring. The Actions column stays pinned right.
- The Approvals Inbox table sits in the overflow box, and its own Table wrapper no longer scrolls.
- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no new inline style.

## Target 3: Actions column

- `ObjectGrid` draws the Actions column only when at least one row on screen offers an inline button or a menu item. Each row's plan comes from `planRowActionMenu`, with the same inputs `RowActionMenu` draws the cell from: capability-gated action definitions, per-record visibility predicates, and the row's edit and delete verdicts (grid, `rowOperations` and record level, now resolved by one shared helper). A grid whose rows offer nothing draws no column. A grid with row actions keeps its pinned column.

## Deviations

- One published member, `TableColumn.chips`, in `@object-ui/types`: declared, mirrored in zod, and tombstoned on the static table surface, as `masked` was. The table cannot tell a chip from text otherwise.
- New shared files in `packages/components/src/custom/`, as the ruling asks. The package entry publishes three names from them: `HorizontalOverflowBox`, `HorizontalOverflowBoxProps` and `PINNED_RIGHT_SEAM_SHADOW_CLASSES`.
- `RowActionMenu.emptyGuard.test.tsx`, case "every row suppressed", asserted the empty Actions header this card removes. It now asserts no column.
- The data-table guide gains "Chip columns" and "Wide tables" sections.
- The claim was amended to cover these files (comment 6225863712).
